## New
- Playlists say when YouTube hides unavailable videos (#1358)
- The "not a bot" error can reset the YouTube session in one tap (#1354)

## Fixed
- Flow no longer crashes on first launch while it creates its settings (#1355) (#1362)
- The crash screen shows a report once instead of on every launch (#1355)
- Status bar icons stay readable over the open video player in light theme (#1375)
- The system equalizer now changes how Flow sounds (#1373)
- Playlists made only of Shorts load again (#1358)
- A playlist that stops loading partway no longer shortens your saved copy (#1358)
- When every YouTube client asks to confirm you're not a bot, Flow retries once with a fresh session (#1354)
